title: Remux – an open-source tmux workspace designed for iPhone
claim: Show HN: Remux – an open-source tmux workspace designed for iPhone
why_good: An open-source tmux workspace designed for the iPhone — a sharp niche for devs who want a real terminal workflow on mobile.
value: Prosumer app: a paid tier (sync, cloud hosts, key management) for mobile power-devs; App Store distribution.
risk: Tiny mobile-dev niche; Apple's limits on background/terminal apps and existing SSH clients cap the ceiling.
pick_reason: The project is an open-source tool that lacks a clear monetization strategy.

zh.claim: Show HN: Remux —— 为 iPhone 设计的开源 tmux 工作区。
zh.why_good: 一个为 iPhone 设计的开源 tmux 工作区——给想在手机上有真正终端工作流的开发者的锋利细分。
zh.value: 专业 app:付费档(同步、云主机、密钥管理)卖给移动重度开发者;走 App Store 分发。
zh.risk: 移动开发细分很小;Apple 对后台/终端 app 的限制和现有 SSH 客户端压住天花板。
